description: Cross-language SDK parity fixtures. The TypeScript (@caveman-ai/sdk) and Python (caveman_cloud) SDKs each run EVERY operation below against a mocked transport and assert the same wire request (method, path, header set, body) and the same derived result. A field present in one SDK and absent in the other makes one side's assertion fail — so this file is a release gate: change one SDK without the other and CI goes red. Both SDKs MUST implement a handler for every operation; a missing handler is a failure, never a skip. An operation with a `status` is answered with that HTTP status and its `response` as the body; its `expect.result.error` is the error the call raises (status, code, message, request_id).
